Punkcraft was built for players who miss the feeling of long-term Minecraft servers.

Explore a massive world, master powerful skills, discover rare materials, complete challenging quests, collect unique treasures, defeat powerful bosses, and build something that lasts.

Whether you enjoy building, exploring, fishing, collecting, grinding, trading, boss hunting, or simply relaxing with friends, Punkcraft offers years of progression without pay-to-win shortcuts.
